card.name: Unused outlets and causes of death
card.fires_on: Fires on "unused" or "electrical" before "outlets" in child-safety advice about plug protectors. Also fires on "of" in "Although the causes of death were varied" in antipsychotic dementia warnings.

modes.label: Outlet safety wording
modes.description: Words just before "outlets" in tips about covering electrical outlets around children.
modes.example: certain television sets and other heavy items are secure so they cannot be tipped over. ___ Remove unnecessary extension cords. ___ Put plug protectors in any unused<< electrical>> outlets when children are present. ___ Move

modes.label: Causes of death phrase
modes.description: The word "of" in "the causes of death were varied" after a drug-versus-placebo death rate.
